creative_drafts.name: Your biggest time sink
creative_drafts.headline: Could AI help with your biggest time sink?
creative_drafts.primary_text:
What is the one job in your business that keeps eating up time?

It might be admin, customer enquiries, scheduling, invoicing or something else entirely.

Tell me a little about your business. We’ll look at how you do that job now, whether AI could help, and a sensible place to start.

Answer the quick questions and I’ll get in touch. — Ivan
creative_drafts.spoken_script: If you could take one time-consuming job off your plate, what would it be? I’m Ivan from Flowstate. I help business owners work out where AI could actually be useful. Tell me what’s taking up your time and show me how you do it now. We’ll look at whether AI could speed it up, take care of part of it, or whether it needs a different approach. Answer the quick questions below and let’s have a chat.

creative_drafts.name: What keeps coming back to you?
creative_drafts.headline: What keeps coming back to you?
creative_drafts.primary_text:
You’ve got a team and software, but there’s still that job that keeps landing back on your desk.

What is it in your business?

I’d like to hear how it works and see whether AI could make it easier. That might mean training your team, improving the process or setting something up around the tools you already use.

Answer a few quick questions and we’ll find a useful place to start. — Ivan
creative_drafts.spoken_script: What’s the job that keeps coming back to you? The information someone needs, the admin that piles up, or the same thing you end up explaining again? That’s what I’d like to look at with you. I’m Ivan from Flowstate. We’ll start with how your business actually works and see where AI could help. Sometimes that’s training, sometimes a better process, sometimes automation. Tell me a little about your business in the form below and I’ll get in touch.
